summary.headline: HJ Shipbuilding wins KRW 51.8bn Bucheon residential redevelopment contract (2.60% of sales)
summary.what_happened: HJ Shipbuilding & Construction disclosed a contract for the Wonjong-dong Yurim·Sinyoung·Somang·Myeongjin street-home redevelopment project in Bucheon, Gyeonggi Province, with the Wonjong-dong redevelopment association as counterparty. The contract amount is KRW 51,812,866,780 (VAT excluded, 100% of the company's share); the company states the original contract of Jun 9, 2022 was KRW 35,509,073,200 and was below the disclosure threshold until this amended contract.

key_numbers.label: Construction period
key_numbers.value: 30 months from actual start of construction

summary.why_it_matters: Supply and construction contract disclosures in Korea are required when a contract exceeds a set share of recent sales, and they give shareholders a view of the order backlog and the scale of individual projects. Amendments that push a previously undisclosed contract above the threshold are typically disclosed for this reason.
